latestVersion.changelog:
ai-promotion-query 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides data query capabilities for Tencent Musicians’ promotion (宣推) stats, triggered by user prompts about promotion performance, diagnosis, or suggestions.
- Integrates two main scenarios: promotion overview (account-level & song summary) and single-song promotion metrics (by songId), with stage-based diagnosis and suggestions leveraging a local knowledge base.
- All backend API calls are delegated to the tme-openapi skill, requiring no direct API scripting in this skill.
- Outputs are designed for internal use by the upper-layer agent and must be structured, strictly avoiding exposure of raw numerical data or technical fields to users, per ai-promotion/readme.md.
- Includes robust handling for edge cases, such as no promotion data, authorization issues, or ambiguous song queries.
